panels.description: Alex follows the hidden pipe through a cramped service trench behind the pump station. The pipe descends through the foundation; dry taps and the tightening non-recognizable queue are visible above, with the uphill conduit and distant infrastructure visibly climbing away toward Halyard. Leave upper-right clear for the off-panel warning.

The newer pipe enters an open foundation breach. Clearly adjacent and separate is the concrete-sealed pit-rim mine entrance with faded hazard stripes and a forbidden marker, shown as a solid closed mass. Beyond the breach are damp rock, rusted rail, and darkness. Leave upper-left clear for dialogue.

Alex shines his work light through the open breach. Condensation beads on the newer pipe and an old amber gauge glows below. Put Bi11bot’s balloon upper-left and Alex’s balloon lower-right, with a clear vertical reading path.

Alex slings the tool bag over his shoulder and steps into the maintenance breach. Bi11bot folds into a compact bundle with one amber eye open. Keep the distant AUTHORIZED ALLOCATION: NORMAL display far left and separate from lettering. Reserve upper-left for Alex’s first balloon, lower-left for his second, upper-right for Bi11bot’s first reply, and lower-right for his final reply.

items.speaker: QUEUE WORKER
items.text: Last warning! If the line doesn’t recover, the remaining allocation goes uphill!

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: It’s not a route. It’s a maintenance gap.
